title: When Scale Meets Diversity: Evaluating Language Models on Fine-Grained Multilingual Claim Verification

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing micro-F1 and macro-F1 scores across language models to assess their tendency to shortcut and favor frequent veracity categories over rare ones in highly imbalanced datasets.
Evaluating out-of-domain and zero-shot cross-lingual generalization across 25 languages to identify performance degradation and representation disparities for underrepresented languages.
